name: City and County of San Francisco
parent_override_note: San Francisco is a consolidated city-county. For jurisdiction purposes it is treated as both county and city.
disclaimer: SF has complex planning rules, historic districts, and discretionary review processes that interact with state ADU law. Verify with SF Planning Dept and SF DBI.

notes: SF Planning Code Sections 207.1 and 207.2 govern ADUs.
Most ADUs in SF are interior conversions of existing space (basement, garage) due to lot density.
Historic districts (approx. 25% of the city) may have additional design constraints.
State law preempts most SF discretionary review for ADUs.
SF's tight lot sizes often mean ADUs are in-law units rather than detached structures.
